formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; ¬∃ (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x2 ∧ x2.size ≤ (63 : ℕ) ∧ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.HasLineDegree ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ)) (Finset.range (13 : ℕ)) x2 (1 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x3 x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (∃ x5 ∈ x1, x3 = x4 + x5) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ)) x2 fun (x6 : Fin ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ))) => Decidable.decide (x6 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x3 ∨ x6 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x4)) = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), (∀ x4 ∉ x3, ∃ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (∀ x7 ∈ x3, ¬∃ x9 ∈ x1, x7 = x6 + x9) ∧ ∃ x7 ∈ x1, x4 = x6 + x7) → ((¬∃ (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ x6 ∈ x3, ∃ x8 ∈ x1, x6 = x5 + x8) ∧ ¬∃ (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (∀ x7 ∈ x3, ¬∃ x9 ∈ x1, x7 = x6 + x9) → ∃ x8 ∈ x1, x5 = x6 + x8) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ)) x2 fun (x6 : Fin ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ))) => Decidable.decide ((∃ x7 ∈ x3, x6 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x7) ∨ ∃ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x6 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x7 ∧ ∀ x8 ∈ x3, ¬∃ x10 ∈ x1, x8 = x7 + x10)) = Bool.false)
